name: Can I replace just a few broken tiles, or do I need to replace the entire bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just a few broken tiles, or do I need to replace the entire bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can replace just a few broken tiles or need a full floor replacement depends on several factors. If you have spare tiles that perfectly match the existing ones and the damage is isolated to a small area with an intact subfloor, spot replacement is often possible. However, if the tiles are discontinued, the damage is widespread, the subfloor has significant water damage, or you desire a refreshed look, a full replacement is usually more practical and provides a more cohesive, long-lasting result. We can assess your specific situation to recommend the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can replace a few broken tiles if you have matching spares and localized damage. A full replacement is necessary for widespread damage, subfloor issues, or if you want a new look.
